verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never says a free plan includes a usable scheduling or booking link. The only 'free' mention (savvycal-docs-14) covers meeting polls, which is a different feature from a booking link. The pricing-page items list plan features such as calendars, delegation, custom domains and own-address emails, but none says which tier is free or what it includes.

support.subject: As a founder, the free tier covers real individual scheduling — a usable booking link without a paid plan
